import sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
pd.set_option('display.width', 250); pd.set_option('display.max_columns', 60); pd.set_option('display.max_rows', 200)
W = sys.argv[1]
si = pd.read_csv(W + '/sample_info.tsv', sep='\t')
print(si.shape); print(si.dtypes)
for c in ['body_site', 'assay', 'region', 'group', 'group_type', 'age', 'age_group', 'sex', 'panel', 'timepoint', 'dominant_genus']:
    print('==', c, si[c].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print(pd.crosstab(si.panel, si.timepoint))
print('samples per subject:', si.subject.value_counts().value_counts().to_dict())
print('group==timepoint all:', (si.group == si.timepoint).all())
print(si.sample_id.tolist())
# fastq header parse: instrument:run:flowcell:lane
h = si.fastq_header_line1.str.split(' ', n=1).str[1]
parts = h.str.split(':', expand=True)
si['instr'] = parts[0]; si['run'] = parts[1]; si['flowcell'] = parts[2]; si['lane'] = parts[3]
si['readname'] = si.fastq_header_line1.str.split(' ').str[0]
print(pd.crosstab([si.instr, si.run, si.flowcell, si.lane], si.timepoint))
print(pd.crosstab(si.panel, si.flowcell))
print(si[['sample_id', 'readname']].assign(match=si.apply(lambda r: r.readname.startswith('@' + r.sample_id), axis=1)).match.value_counts())
si.to_csv(sys.argv[2] + '/si_parsed.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
